paper_metadata.title: Effect of Zr addition on the mechanical properties of Nb-Si based alloys

evidence.quote: Effect of Zr addition on the mechanical properties of arc melted hypoeutectic Nb-16 at.%Si alloy has been investigated.
Four alloy pancakes with nominal compositions of Nb-16Si%(A2), Nb-16Si%-2Zr%(AZ2), Nb-16Si%-4Zr% (AZ4) and Nb-16Si%-6Zr%(AZ6) were used in the present study.
